title: Distance Stability for the Integral Hardy and Carleman Inequalities
summary: We study stability forms of two classical integral inequalities: Hardy's integral inequality and the integral Carleman inequality, also known as the Pólya--Knopp inequality. The sharp constants in these two inequalities are $(p')^p$ and $e$, respectively, but neither inequality has a non-trivial extremizer in its natural function space. Their formal extremal functions are $c x^{-1/p}$ and $c/x$, respectively. We first derive a deficit identity for Hardy's integral inequality.
